name: Infinite Plane Ray Intersection
definition: Computes the intersection of a ray with an infinite plane defined by a point p0World and normal nWorld. Returns the intersection distance tHit and fills an Intersection struct, or rejects if parallel or outside the ray segment.
summary: Infinite Plane Ray Intersection analytically computes ray-plane intersections in constant time, typically serving as a separate ground plane outside the scene's BVH for efficient testing.
